# Sourcely

> Sourcely is a sourcing service for small sellers outside China. We shortlist established Chinese factories for a seller's product, contact them in Mandarin, and deliver an English side-by-side quote comparison within 48 hours. Paid plans add hand inspection of physical samples and bulk-order coordination. Tagline: "Start your side hustle without getting burned."

## Key facts
- Audience: Gen Z, side-hustle and small online sellers outside China who want to buy from Chinese factories.
- First report: a comparison of three factories (price, minimum order, lead time, sample cost, supplier background, recommendation, watch-outs), delivered within 48 hours.
- Free pilot: the first 10 sellers receive the factory comparison report free. No account is required; each order has a private link, and an optional passwordless account is available.
- Paid plans: Sample (hand inspection of physical samples) and Full Order (production tracking and bulk-order inspection coordination), each a flat upfront fee. Sample fees and international shipping are paid by the buyer.
- Founder: Hanxi Zhu, Mandarin-speaking, based in the United States.
- Stage: pilot. Sourcely does not guarantee bulk production quality.
